run_merge_traj: run the merge_traj script on a directory of VASP relaxation runs to merge checkpoints into full trajectories
extract_file_from_zip: extract a specific file from a zip archive to a target directory using extract_file
merge_vasp_checkpoints: merge VASP relaxation checkpoint zip files into a single ASE trajectory file
review_main_function: review the main function that loops through adsorbate directories and merges intermediate checkpoints into full trajectories
refactor_extract_file: refactor extract_file to support extracting multiple files from a zip archive at once
